reviews.text: This lotion is extremely watery and light weight, if you're looking for something more moisturising i'd go for the dokdo lotion instead. Because of its watery texture, it takes a bit more time to fully absorb. After applying it leaves my skin hydrated and refreshed tho, but not much moisturises, you don't feel that good occlusive feeling that other moisturiser give. From my experience it has been a lovely day summer time lotion. I do not suggest it for colder weather unless your skin is really really oily
reviews.zh: 呢款乳液好水、好輕盈。如果你想要補濕多啲嘅，我會建議揀 dokdo 乳液。因為質地好水，要多啲時間先可以完全吸收。搽完之後皮膚有水潤清新嘅感覺，但補濕效果唔算多，冇其他保濕霜嗰種封閉感。我嘅體驗係，佢係一款夏天日間好好用嘅乳液。天凍嗰陣我唔建議用，除非你皮膚真係非常非常油。

reviews.text: This lotion feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, which I like. It helps calm the skin a bit and feels gentle. However, the hydration doesn’t last very long, so I feel like I need to reapply or use another moisturizer on top. Overall, it’s okay but not very impressive for me.
reviews.zh: 呢款乳液質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會黏，我好鍾意。佢有少少舒緩皮膚嘅作用，感覺溫和。不過，保濕效果持續唔係好耐，所以我覺得要重新搽或者再加另一款保濕霜。整體嚟講，都幾好，但係對我嚟講唔係好出色。

reviews.text: i have combo skin, and this works really well to hydrate and calm it down. my skin is also pretty dehydrated, so i love layering this lotion twice because its a light milky gel cream consistency, probably wouldnt be an issue to layer on oily skin too because its so light; kinda feels like a hybrid between a toner, serum, and cream, pretty much like a three in one !! really nice soothing properties, no fragrance and great for redness-prone skin, plus lots of product in one bottle (250ml). also the packaging is adorable, i love round lab for this too. i really recommend this, especially for dehydrated skin <3
reviews.zh: 我係混合皮膚，呢款好有效咁補水同舒緩。我皮膚都幾缺水，所以我好鍾意疊搽兩次，因為佢係輕盈嘅奶狀啫喱霜質地，油性皮膚疊用應該都冇問題，因為佢好輕。感覺似化妝水、精華同面霜嘅混合體，基本上係三合一！舒緩效果好好，冇香味，對容易泛紅嘅皮膚都好好，而且一支就有好多產品（250ml）。包裝都好可愛，我都好鍾意 Round Lab 呢點。我好推薦，尤其係缺水嘅皮膚 <3

reviews.text:
I’ve been using this product for a while now, and it’s one of those Korean skincare finds that truly lives up to the hype. The texture is very comfortable — it spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and leaves no sticky or heavy feeling on the skin.

After application, my skin feels well-hydrated, calm, and refreshed. Over time, I noticed that my skin barrier feels more balanced, with less dryness and irritation. It works gently but effectively, which is exactly what I look for in skincare.

Another big plus is how easily it fits into a routine. It layers well with other products, doesn’t cause pilling, and works perfectly both in the morning and evening. It also sits nicely under makeup.
reviews.zh:
我一直用緊呢款，佢係 K-beauty 入面真係名副其實嘅好產品。質地好舒服，好易推開，吸收快，搽完冇黏膩或者厚重感。

用完之後，我嘅皮膚感覺補水、平靜同清新。長時間用落，我留意到皮膚屏障更加平衡，乾燥同刺激都減少咗。佢作用溫和但有效，正正係我喺護膚品入面想要嘅效果。

另外一個大優點，係佢好易融入日常護理。同其他產品配合得好，唔會搓泥，早上同晚上都好好用，化妝之下都好服貼。

reviews.text: With the first few trys i got little whiteheads on my cheeks and chin, but after using it for a few weeks, my skin got used to it.I use it 2-3 a week when I'm not using my tretinoin and my face looks good after applying it. Really lightweight, non sticky and non drying. My boyfriend is also using it because it's a huge bottle and for him its enough after washing his face.
reviews.zh: 頭幾次用嗰陣，我面頰同下巴出咗啲白頭粉刺，但用咗幾個星期之後，皮膚就適應咗。我每星期用 2 至 3 次，唔用 tretinoin 嗰陣先用，搽完面睇落好好。質地好輕，唔黏、唔乾。男朋友都有用，因為瓶好大，佢洗完面用都夠。

reviews.text:
Wanted to find an alternative to the ongredients calming lotion, so I decided to try this one.
I think it's a light lotion, I find it to be more suited for summer rather than for winter. I liked it but it's nothing exceptional. But if you're considering buying this instead of the pine calming cica cream, then I recommend to buy the lotion: texture is the same, but there is more product. I've used both and couldn't really find a difference.
Keep in mind the lotion is pine scented
reviews.zh:
我想搵 ongredients calming lotion 嘅替代品，所以試吓呢款。我覺得係一款輕盈嘅乳液，比較適合夏天多過冬天。我幾鍾意，但冇特別驚喜。如果你考慮買呢款代替 pine calming cica cream，我會建議揀乳液：質地一樣，但產品份量多啲。我兩款都用過，都搵唔到咩分別。
留意，呢款乳液係松木（pine）香味。

reviews.text: I love all products from Round Lab, and I really liked this lotion as well. I don’t know why I ignored the lotion format for so long. For hot weather, it’s an absolute gem - like a sip of cold water, it cools and soothes instantly. The bottle is huge, so there’s plenty for the neck and décolletage too. An excellent product - highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 Round Lab 所有產品，呢款乳液我都好鍾意。唔知點解我之前一直忽略乳液型式。天氣熱嗰陣，佢係絕對嘅寶物，好似飲咗一啖凍水咁，即時涼爽、舒緩。瓶好大，頸同胸口都夠用。非常出色，極力推薦！

reviews.text:
This Calming Lotion has become my go-to product for soothing my skin! From the moment I apply it, I feel a wave of relaxation. The texture is light, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and comforted without any sticky residue.

It has a gentle, calming scent that’s not overpowering—just a subtle, relaxing fragrance that helps me unwind after a long day. I’ve noticed a significant improvement in how my skin feels—less irritated, more balanced, and deeply hydrated.

Perfect for sensitive skin, it has a cooling effect that really helps to calm redness or inflammation. If you’re looking for a lotion to de-stress your skin and mind, this one is a must! I can’t recommend it enough for anyone needing a moment of calm in their skincare routine.
reviews.zh:
呢款舒緩乳液已經成為我舒緩皮膚嘅首選產品！由我搽上去嗰一刻開始，就感覺到一陣放鬆。質地輕盈、唔油膩，吸收快，令皮膚感覺柔軟、舒適，亦冇任何黏膩殘留。

佢有一種溫和、舒緩嘅香味，唔會太濃，只係淡淡嘅、令人放鬆嘅香味，幫我喺漫長一日之後平靜下嚟。我留意到皮膚感覺有明顯改善——冇咁刺激、更加平衡，同埋深層補濕。

對於敏感皮膚嚟講非常好，佢嘅清涼效果真係有助舒緩泛紅或者發炎。如果你想搵一款令皮膚同心情都放鬆嘅乳液，呢款絕對係必備！我極力推薦俾任何需要喺護膚程序入面得到一刻平靜嘅人。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
